story.iWant: to delete or archive old sessions

tasks.task: Implement session delete in SessionManager (AC: #1) Add delete() method that removes session directory Use shutil.rmtree for directory removal Return boolean success status
Add CLI delete command (AC: #1) Add session delete command with confirmation Implement y/N prompt using click.confirm Add --force flag to skip confirmation Call SessionManager.delete()

Implement session archive in SessionManager (AC: #2) Add archive() method Create archive/ subdirectory if not exists Compress session directory to .tar.gz using tarfile Move archive to validation-sessions/archive/ Remove original directory after successful archive

Add CLI archive command (AC: #2, #3) Add session archive command for single session Add --older-than option with duration parsing (e.g., "30d") Implement bulk archival logic Report count of archived sessions

Implement cleanup command (AC: #4) Add session cleanup command Find FAILED sessions with empty findings Find SUPERSEDED sessions Show candidates for cleanup Require confirmation before deletion Report count deleted
Add --dry-run support (AC: #5) Add --dry-run flag to delete, archive, cleanup When dry-run: show what would happen, don't execute Clear messaging: "Would delete:", "Would archive:"

Write unit tests (AC: #6) Test delete removes directory Test archive creates .tar.gz in archive/ Test --older-than duration parsing Test cleanup finds correct candidates Test --dry-run doesn't modify files

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Session delete command implemented - rustybt-validate session delete session_id requires confirmation (y/N prompt), --force flag skips confirmation, removes session directory and all contents

Session archive command implemented - rustybt-validate session archive session_id compresses session to .tar.gz, moves to validation-sessions/archive/ subdirectory, preserves session for future reference
Bulk archive with age filter - rustybt-validate session archive --older-than 30d archives all sessions older than specified age, reports count of archived sessions

Session cleanup command implemented - rustybt-validate session cleanup finds FAILED sessions with no findings, finds SUPERSEDED sessions, requires confirmation before deletion, reports count of deleted sessions
Support --dry-run for preview - All destructive commands support --dry-run, shows what would be deleted/archived without doing it

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Sessions stored in validation-sessions/{session_id}/. Archive location: validation-sessions/archive/. Cleanup targets: FAILED (no findings), SUPERSEDED.

doc.title: Epic 3: Session Management System
doc.snippet: Use shutil.rmtree for recursive directory deletion. Use tarfile module for compression. Support --dry-run for preview. Require confirmation for destructive operations.

doc.title: Story 3.4 - Duplicate Prevention
doc.snippet: SUPERSEDED status added to Session model - cleanup target. find_sessions() can filter by status to find cleanup candidates.
